---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

This page examines the relationship between a film's budget and its worldwide revenue. Figure @fig-budget-revenue shows whether films with larger budgets tend to generate higher worldwide revenues.

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Film budget versus worldwide revenue"

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (USD millions)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (USD millions)")
plt.title("Film Budget vs. Worldwide Revenue")
plt.show()
```
